## Publication Information

**Date:** 1884

**Imprint:** <i>English Illustrated Magazine</i> 1 (June-July 1884), 563-73, 628-39.

**Notes:** Reprinted in the collections <i>The Author of 'Beltraffio'</i> (Boston: Osgood 1885) and <i>Stories Revived</i> (London: Macmillan 1885).
